region.description: The streams' AWS region. Default: the AWS default config's.

endpoint.description: A Kinesis-compatible endpoint: an emulator's, or a VPC endpoint.

accessKeyId.description: An AWS access key. Without one, the AWS default credentials.

schemaRegistryUrl.description: A Confluent-compatible schema registry. Avro and Protobuf need one.

schemaRegistryUsername.description: A user for the schema registry's basic authentication. Unset: none.

format.description: How records' data is encoded. Avro and Protobuf use the schema registry's wire format; string reads each record as text.

streams.description: The Kinesis streams to offer as streams. Empty: every stream the credentials can list.

streamPattern.description: A regular expression streams must match to be offered.

startPosition.description: Where a shard's first read starts: its oldest record, or records that arrive after the read starts.
